confound: S-box, KEY and TRIAL STREAM are confounded across the main arms: each arm derives its own AES key from its own seed, so the three r=5 main arms carry three distinct key_hex values and three distinct splitmix64 streams.
consequence: This design CANNOT assign an arm-to-arm difference to the S-box rather than to the key or the stream. Concretely: Y-R1-main measured 22 hits and Y-R2-main measured 41 at equal exposure, a difference at two-sided p = 0.0226 under the exact conditional binomial test; this design cannot say whether that is the S-box, the key, the stream or chance.
what_IS_free_of_this_confound: the r=5 vs r=6 comparison, because each r=6 arm reuses its r=5 counterpart's seed and arm id, giving an identical key and an identical trial stream with rounds as the only changed variable.
what_would_fix_it: replicate each S-box across several independently derived keys and streams at fixed exposure, and/or run the AES S-box and a random S-box under the SAME key. Not run here: budget.
recorded_because: the red team raised it and it is a real limit on the arm-to-arm comparison, though it does not bear on the ALIVE/DEAD verdict of any single arm against its own matched null.
